protocol_name: AROMA TallyQA Natural-OOD Multi-Action Oracle Forensics
reason: Frozen zero-shot TallyQA evaluation showed significant negative transfer. This diagnostic separates actuator repair opportunity from controller action-selection failure.
head: L18H13
oracle_definition: For each baseline-wrong sample, repairable iff at least one frozen non-NOOP action produces the correct numeral. Baseline-correct samples retain NOOP. This is an oracle upper bound and is not deployable.
gt_policy: GT is read only after baseline and all five fixed action states have been produced.
purpose: separate actuator failure from routing failure
